name: GE Vernova Inc.
research_rationale: Yahoo debut-gain stories and a Nov dip headline add no filings; filed FY25 FCF still trails screen TTM, so research only partly supports the buy signal.

weekly_updates.summary:
News flow is mixed: commentaries cite higher 2026 Power/Electrification targets, while Wind losses, execution risk and a ~14% monthly share decline dominate recent headlines.
Erste Group reportedly downgraded GEV; HSBC had upgraded to Buy (Wind “past the worst”) in late October—both unverified beyond press summaries in the batch.
Sourced SEC annual cash flow is unchanged (FY2025 10-K OCF $4.99bn, FCF $3.71bn, dividends $275m); Yahoo TTM FCF remains far above filed annual FCF.

Same-day press cites an AI-energy rebound and fair-valuation debate after a cooled run; one piece frames GEV versus CAT as a deeper, riskier snapback—no new SEC filings in the batch.  
Filed FY2025 cash flow in sources is unchanged (OCF $4.99bn, FCF $3.71bn); Yahoo TTM FCF (~$17.1bn) still far exceeds annual filed FCF underpinning the screen.  
Wind execution and mixed analyst views noted earlier remain the main fundamental overhang; Nvidia leadership commentary is sentiment-only for order visibility.

Latest batch adds Globe and Mail coverage on a ~14.2% monthly decline and Wind risks challenging the Power narrative; no new SEC filings or sourced financial changes.  
Filed FY2025 cash flow in sources remains OCF $4.99bn and FCF $3.71bn; Yahoo TTM FCF (~$17.1bn) still far exceeds annual filed FCF underpinning the screen.  
Other headlines are options-page noise only; Wind execution and FCF-basis divergence remain the main overhangs from prior updates.

Incremental batch is commentary-only: Seeking Alpha frames a FCF jump as a strong buy; Yahoo links AI data-centre power to YTD gains; another piece says momentum still lacks trend confirmation.  
No new SEC filings; sourced FY2025 cash flow is unchanged (OCF $4.99bn, FCF $3.71bn) and Yahoo TTM FCF (~$17.1bn) still far exceeds filed annual FCF underpinning the screen.  
Wind execution and the FCF-basis gap from prior updates are not resolved in this batch.
